title: Hearty American Beef Burger
description: A classic American dish featuring a juicy beef patty, topped with a tangy mustard sauce and served with digestive biscuits and bonito flakes.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef and a pinch of salt and pepper, and mix until just combined.
Form the beef mixture into 4 patties.
Grill the patties for 5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Meanwhile, toast the digestive biscuits by baking them in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yellow mustard and mayonnaise.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of the mustard sauce on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a few slices of lettuce, a tomato slice, a slice of onion, and a few slices of pickle.
Top with the toasted digestive biscuits and sprinkle with bonito flakes.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
